contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ is IMP CAES M DID SEV[ER IVLIAN AVG] ; R/ is [RECTOR ORBIS] S C

A Roman silver coated copper alloy sestertius of Didius Julianus dating to AD 193 (Reece Period 10). Cf RIC 4 (Didius Julianus), 16. The diameter is 16mm. Obverse inscription is IMP CAES M DID SEV[ER IVLIAN AVG] and the reverse inscription is [RECTOR ORBIS] S C. The coin has been clipped
